# Videxpulse Weather Agent - Setup Instructions

- [x] Verify that the copilot-instructions.md file in the .github directory is created.

- [x] Clarify Project Requirements
  - Full-stack weather agent application
  - ReactJS frontend UI for user interaction
  - FastAPI backend for API and orchestration
  - Ollama integration for JSON validation
  - IMD REST API for weather data retrieval

- [ ] Scaffold the Project
  - Create React frontend structure with Vite
  - Create FastAPI backend structure with virtual environment
  - Set up dependencies and configuration files

- [ ] Customize the Project
  - Configure FastAPI routes (/api/chat endpoint)
  - Set up Ollama JSON validation integration
  - Implement IMD API weather data fetching
  - Build ReactJS chat UI component

- [ ] Install Required Extensions
  - Python extension for FastAPI development
  - ES7+ React/Redux/React-Native snippets

- [ ] Compile/Install Dependencies
  - Install frontend dependencies (npm)
  - Install backend dependencies (pip)
  - Verify all packages are correctly installed

- [ ] Create and Run Tasks
  - Frontend dev server (npm run dev)
  - Backend dev server (uvicorn main:app --reload)
  - Both services running concurrently

- [ ] Launch the Project
  - Start backend FastAPI server (localhost:8000)
  - Start frontend React dev server (localhost:5173)
  - Test API connectivity

- [ ] Ensure Documentation is Complete
  - Update README.md with architecture overview
  - Add setup and run instructions
  - Document API endpoints and data flow
